description: This PHP class defines an AWS SDK client for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, and listing models and jobs related to Amazon Bedrock.

classes.name: BedrockClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Bedrock service via AWS SDK.

methods.name: $method annotations
methods.description: Annotations for various API methods provided by the BedrockClient, including async and sync variants, for operations like creating, deleting, and listing models and jobs.
